additional_info.subject: Tickets (unfortunately not) resolved
additional_info.body:
Dear Siemens-Team.
In July, we created several tickets to install screensavers for a limited-time marketing campaign. These screensavers were supposed to be removed at the end of the campaign period.
Today, I received a photo from a colleague of a charger at the Lehrte site that still displays the summer campaign (see below). The following ticket numbers are affected:
00440324, -327, -330 and -331
.
In the ticket communication, I pointed out several times that I had to rely on the tickets being removed or resolved because I did not have read access at the time.
How do we ensure that the summer campaign is removed from all screens?
Kind regards,
Alexandra
Alexandra Becker
Operations Manager Customer Success
